title: Rework Service Levels Under the Workmanship Warranties
content:
For a covered concern remedied under a Workmanship Warranties plan, the plan sets the rework target, the courtesy transport the network provides, recalibration of disturbed sensors, the escalation point for repeated unresolved reworks, and the chip credit of the Chip Repair Guarantee.

| Service level | Chip Repair Guarantee | Calibration Workmanship Warranty | Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Target business days to complete a covered rework (0 means credit only) | 0 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 5 | 7 |
| Courtesy rental days the network pays for a covered rework | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 3 | 5 |
| Rework target days above which the courtesy rental is offered | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| Distance within which a courtesy ride is offered for rework drop-off (miles) | 0 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 15 | 15 |
| Sensors disturbed by a covered rework are recalibrated at no charge | no | yes | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Covered reworks on one concern that ended not resolved after which the concern goes to the regional warranty manager (0 means not applicable) | 0 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Amount paid for the chip repair is credited toward a windshield replacement by the network when the chip spreads | yes | no | no | no | no | no |

## Notes

- The Chip Repair Guarantee's rework target of 0 means credit only: its remedy is the chip credit, and it carries no courtesy ride, courtesy rental or escalation count.
- The plan's courtesy rental days are 3 under the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty and 5 under the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty, and 0 under the other four plans. The rework target days above which the courtesy rental is offered are 1 under those two plans and 0 under the others.
- A courtesy ride for rework drop-off is offered within 10 miles under the Calibration, Cosmetic Repair and Glass Installation plans, and within 15 miles under the Collision Lifetime and Certified Structural Lifetime plans.
- Under every plan except the Chip Repair Guarantee, the escalation figure is 2 covered reworks on one concern that ended not resolved.

## Hypothetical comparison

A covered paint concern under a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty is targeted at 5 business days; the same concern under a Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty is targeted at 7 business days. A covered concern under a Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty is targeted at 1 business day, with a courtesy ride within 10 miles.
